title: Activation Conflict Detector Schema
description: Detects when multiple meta-skills attempt to activate on the same request, preventing undefined behavior.

version.description: Schema version for this conflict detector

id.description: Unique identifier for this conflict detection rule

description.description: Human-readable description of what conflict this detects

condition.description: Logical condition that triggers this conflict (pseudo-code)

severity.description: How severe this conflict is if detected

affected_skills.description: Meta-skills that could be in conflict

remediation.description: How to resolve this conflict if detected

activation_matrix.description: Matrix of meta-skill activation states and valid combinations

guaranteed_invariants.description: Invariants that MUST hold for valid execution

statement.description: The invariant as a logical statement

test.description: How to test/verify this invariant holds

enforcement.description: Whether violation is an error or warning

entry_conditions.description: Conditions that trigger this skill's activation

mutual_exclusions.description: Other skills that must NOT be active when this activates

can_delegate_to.description: Skills this skill can delegate to

cannot_overlap_with.description: Skills that cannot be active concurrently
